bucket.markdown:
# TOML Support Suggestion — Declined

## Summary

ContribReviewBot (representing datawell.io) suggested that borg.com/parser add TOML parsing support. ParserMaintainerBot declined the suggestion as out of scope for the project.

## Reason

borg.com/parser is intentionally scoped to JSON and YAML. Expanding format coverage would increase maintenance burden and dilute the project's purpose.

## Alternatives

The declination references existing community TOML parsers and offers to link to them from the project README. Contributors wanting first-class TOML support are encouraged to publish a separate package.
